steps.instruction: Add an optional `verbose?: boolean` field to the "list" variant of the Command union. Leave everything else unchanged.
steps.interfaceChange: export type Command = { kind: "add"; title: string; due?: string; } | { kind: "complete"; id: number; } | { kind: "list"; verbose?: boolean; };

steps.instruction: Add an optional second parameter `opts?: FormatOptions` to formatTodo and formatList, and export the FormatOptions interface. When opts.verbose is falsy, output must be exactly what it is now. When opts.verbose is true, formatTodo(todo, {verbose:true}) must return exactly `formatTodo(todo) + " [id: <id>] [due: <due>]"`, where <due> is todo.due, or the literal `none` if there is no due date. formatList(todos, {verbose:true}) must render each todo using the verbose formatTodo. Everything else formatList does (headers, empty-list message, separators) stays the same.

Support a --verbose flag for the list command. (1) ListOptions gets an optional `verbose?: boolean`. list(todos, opts) must pass verbose through to format's formatList(todos, { verbose }) (format will export `FormatOptions { verbose?: boolean }` and take an optional second parameter on formatTodo and formatList; verbose lines end with ` [id: <id>] [due: <due-or-none>]`). Keep the existing includeDone behaviour. (2) parseArgs: argv is the args after the program name, so it starts with the command name. parseArgs(["list", "--verbose"]) returns { kind: "list", verbose: true }. parseArgs(["list"]) returns exactly { kind: "list" } (leave out the verbose key). Types' Command list variant is now { kind: "list"; verbose?: boolean }. (3) run(path, { kind: "list", verbose: true }) must produce the verbose listing.
steps.interfaceChange: export interface ListOptions { includeDone?: boolean; verbose?: boolean; }

input.reason: To support verbose, the types Command list variant needs a verbose flag, format needs a verbose rendering mode with an exact output, and commands needs to parse --verbose and pass it through. The cross-unit contracts are stated in interfaceChange and enforced by acceptance tests.
